# Alternative.me

> > Alternative.me is a comprehensive platform offering software alternatives, Discord bot directories with command references, cryptocurrency market sentiment tools, and product reviews across 12,846+ products.

The site serves two primary audiences: users seeking software alternatives and comparisons, and Discord community managers looking for bots like Groovy Bot, UnbelievaBoat, Mantaro, and Rythm. It also features the popular Crypto Fear & Greed Index for Bitcoin market sentiment analysis.

## Key Topics

- Discord bots
- Software alternatives
- Bot commands and slash commands
- Crypto Fear & Greed Index
- Bitcoin market sentiment
- Music bots (Rythm, Groovy Bot, Jockie Music)
- Economy bots (UnbelievaBoat, Mantaro)
- Bot command reference
- Product reviews and comparisons
- Software discovery
- Discord bot directory
- Gaming bots
- Moderation bots (ProBot, UB3R-B0T)
- discord.py development

## Crypto Market Tools

- [Crypto Fear & Greed Index - Bitcoin Sentiment](https://alternative.me/crypto/fear-and-greed-index): Bitcoin/crypto market sentiment analysis via Fear & Greed Index
- [Crypto Dashboard](https://alternative.me/crypto): Crypto dashboard: Bitcoin analytics, coin overview, Fear & Greed Index, API
